statement: 06 is a two-parameter action; regular interpreter sign-extends par16 and par8 without the 07 argc mask.
06 copies 40 bytes of caller context, then changes bp, argNum, flags and efun pointer before the indirect native call.
Native capacity validation alone does not prove that a selected global function table entry is an efun. Rust must use an explicitly typed registry.
vm_getArgument uses context bp+n and exact raw tag or mixed; dispatch does not invoke user-function 0d argument checking.
Callbacks manage native stack values: abs edits its input, time pops argc then pushes its result.
Return count is bp+argc-sp: void requires zero then pushes Void; mixed permits zero or one; exact requires one matching raw tag.
With ctrlFlags bit0x10 or bit4 (mask0x04), 06 skips immediate return; mask0x04 also sets PCB mask0x40. Other nonzero combinations without those masks take normal return.
vm_error reaches errorQuit(-3); traceError drops values before unwinding contexts and skips object unExecRef for efun frames; doActions handles retained script catch state.
The first host interface is synchronous, value-only, explicitly opted in, without reentry or new script-catch error sites.
Flag masks are observed, but complete suspension, PCB resumption, callback hook and JIT scheduling contracts are outside this synchronous specification.
